title: Standardised death rates by cause
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection.
subject: Causes of death - standardised death rate
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, annual age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Age-standardised rates compare regions with different age structures; they are not counts of deaths.
A single year is shown as it is: an exceptional year is visible rather than smoothed. The three-year moving average is a separate dataset.

title: Standardised death rates by cause · 65 years or over
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection. Limited to 65 years or over.
subject: Causes of death - standardised death rate
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, annual age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to 65 years or over.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Age-standardised rates compare regions with different age structures; they are not counts of deaths.
A single year is shown as it is: an exceptional year is visible rather than smoothed. The three-year moving average is a separate dataset.

title: Standardised death rates by cause · Males
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection. Limited to males.
subject: Causes of death - standardised death rate
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, annual age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to males.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Age-standardised rates compare regions with different age structures; they are not counts of deaths.
A single year is shown as it is: an exceptional year is visible rather than smoothed. The three-year moving average is a separate dataset.

title: Standardised death rates by cause · Females
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection. Limited to females.
subject: Causes of death - standardised death rate
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, annual age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to females.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Age-standardised rates compare regions with different age structures; they are not counts of deaths.
A single year is shown as it is: an exceptional year is visible rather than smoothed. The three-year moving average is a separate dataset.

title: Standardised death rates by cause · Less than 65 years, Females
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection. Limited to less than 65 years, females.
subject: Causes of death - standardised death rate
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, annual age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to less than 65 years, females.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Age-standardised rates compare regions with different age structures; they are not counts of deaths.
A single year is shown as it is: an exceptional year is visible rather than smoothed. The three-year moving average is a separate dataset.

title: Standardised death rates by cause · 65 years or over, Females
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death across European regions, from the Eurostat causes of death collection. Limited to 65 years or over, females.
subject: Causes of death - standardised death rate
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_asdr2, annual age-standardised death rates per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to 65 years or over, females.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Age-standardised rates compare regions with different age structures; they are not counts of deaths.
A single year is shown as it is: an exceptional year is visible rather than smoothed. The three-year moving average is a separate dataset.

title: Regional gross domestic product
description: Regional GDP measured the several ways Eurostat publishes it: in euro and in purchasing power standards, per inhabitant and in total, and as an index of the EU27 average.
subject: Gross domestic product (GDP) at current market prices
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat nama_10r_3gdp. Each unit the table publishes becomes an indicator, because they are different measures of the same aggregate rather than the same measure repeated: a total in millions and a value per inhabitant do not compare across regions of different size. National currency is not published here, because a value in national currency is not comparable between countries.

example_questions: Quali regioni hanno il PIL pro capite piu alto rispetto alla media UE?
caveats: Totals and per-inhabitant values are not comparable with each other across regions.
The EU27 index is a relative measure where the average equals 100, not a currency amount.

title: Standardised death rates by cause, three-year moving average · Less than 65 years
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death, averaged over the reference year and the two before it, across European regions. Limited to less than 65 years.
subject: Causes of death - standardised death rate
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_ysdr2, three-year moving averages of age-standardised death rates (the reference year and the two preceding ones) per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to less than 65 years.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Each value is the mean of three consecutive years, so consecutive values share two years: a year-on-year difference is not an annual change.
The annual series is the dataset eurostat-causes-of-death.

title: Standardised death rates by cause, three-year moving average · 65 years or over
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death, averaged over the reference year and the two before it, across European regions. Limited to 65 years or over.
subject: Causes of death - standardised death rate
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_ysdr2, three-year moving averages of age-standardised death rates (the reference year and the two preceding ones) per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to 65 years or over.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Each value is the mean of three consecutive years, so consecutive values share two years: a year-on-year difference is not an annual change.
The annual series is the dataset eurostat-causes-of-death.

title: Standardised death rates by cause, three-year moving average · Males
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death, averaged over the reference year and the two before it, across European regions. Limited to males.
subject: Causes of death - standardised death rate
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_ysdr2, three-year moving averages of age-standardised death rates (the reference year and the two preceding ones) per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to males.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Each value is the mean of three consecutive years, so consecutive values share two years: a year-on-year difference is not an annual change.
The annual series is the dataset eurostat-causes-of-death.

title: Standardised death rates by cause, three-year moving average · Less than 65 years, Males
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death, averaged over the reference year and the two before it, across European regions. Limited to less than 65 years, males.
subject: Causes of death - standardised death rate
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_ysdr2, three-year moving averages of age-standardised death rates (the reference year and the two preceding ones) per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to less than 65 years, males.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Each value is the mean of three consecutive years, so consecutive values share two years: a year-on-year difference is not an annual change.
The annual series is the dataset eurostat-causes-of-death.

title: Standardised death rates by cause, three-year moving average · 65 years or over, Males
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death, averaged over the reference year and the two before it, across European regions. Limited to 65 years or over, males.
subject: Causes of death - standardised death rate
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_ysdr2, three-year moving averages of age-standardised death rates (the reference year and the two preceding ones) per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to 65 years or over, males.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Each value is the mean of three consecutive years, so consecutive values share two years: a year-on-year difference is not an annual change.
The annual series is the dataset eurostat-causes-of-death.

title: Standardised death rates by cause, three-year moving average · Females
description: Age-standardised death rates by cause of death, averaged over the reference year and the two before it, across European regions. Limited to females.
subject: Causes of death - standardised death rate
methodology: Direct extract from Eurostat hlth_cd_ysdr2, three-year moving averages of age-standardised death rates (the reference year and the two preceding ones) per 100 000 inhabitants. Every cause of death the table publishes becomes an indicator of this dataset; the indicators are discovered from the source rather than chosen, and a cause no country reports is not published. Coverage follows the NUTS 2024 geography contract and upstream availability, not a fixed country list. Limited to females.

example_questions: Quali regioni europee hanno la mortalita per tumore piu alta?
Come varia la mortalita per malattie cardiovascolari fra le regioni?
caveats: Each value is the mean of three consecutive years, so consecutive values share two years: a year-on-year difference is not an annual change.
The annual series is the dataset eurostat-causes-of-death.
